script_parts.opening: Namaskar, Gupta ji — main IndiaMART se bol raha hoon. Aapka account kaafi purana hai, 8,600 din se zyada — lekin pichle 30 dinon mein platform pe zero active days hain, aur 3 buyer leads ka koi reply nahi gaya. Isliye seedha call kiya, kyunki yeh pattern hum ignore nahi kar sakte.
script_parts.diagnostic: Gupta ji, aap pehle actively platform use karte the — phir achanak last few months mein engagement bilkul drop ho gayi, almost 70% cliff aa gaya. Kya koi specific wajah rahi — koi operational change, staff issue, ya platform mein koi problem aayi jo aapko rok rahi hai?
script_parts.value_demo: Ek critical cheez batata hoon — aapka PNS success rate sirf 20% hai, matlab 5 mein se 4 buyers jo aapko call kar rahe hain, unhe aap tak pahunch hi nahi pa rahe. Saath hi CQS score 33 hai jo critical zone mein hai, iska seedha matlab hai buyers search mein aapko dhundh nahi pa rahe — yeh leads silently ja rahi hain competitors ke paas.
script_parts.action: Abhi is call pe hum ek kaam karte hain — main aapka PNS setting check karta hoon aur aapke saath milke phone number aur availability hours update karte hain, taaki jo bhi buyer aaj call kare usse aap tak connection ho sake. Bas 2 minute lagenge, aap ready hain?
script_parts.close: Gupta ji, bas yeh ek step aaj complete kar lete hain — PNS fix aur ek lead ka reply. Kal main ek short follow-up message karunga, aur agar aapko catalog ya CQS ke baare mein baat karni ho toh hum next call schedule kar sakte hain — bilkul aapki convenience pe.

script_parts_en.opening: Good day, Gupta ji — I'm calling from IndiaMART. Your account is over 8,600 days old, which shows a long relationship with us — but in the last 30 days there have been zero active days on the platform, and 3 buyer leads have gone completely unanswered. That's why I'm calling directly, because this pattern needs immediate attention.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: Gupta ji, your engagement was strong before, but then around month 5 it dropped almost 70% — a sudden cliff. I want to understand what happened — was there an operational change, a staffing issue, or did you face some specific problem on the platform that made it difficult to stay active?
script_parts_en.value_demo: Here's a critical data point — your PNS success rate is only 20%, meaning 4 out of every 5 buyers who try to reach you through IndiaMART are simply not getting through. On top of that, your CQS score is 33, which is in the critical zone — buyers searching for medical equipment in Ludhiana are not finding your listing, and those leads are silently going to your competitors.
script_parts_en.action: Let's do one concrete thing right now on this call — I'll pull up your PNS settings and we'll update your phone number and availability hours together, so the next buyer who tries to reach you actually gets connected. It'll take just 2 minutes — are you ready to do this now?
script_parts_en.close: Gupta ji, let's just lock in this one step today — fix the PNS and send a reply to at least one of those 3 pending leads. I'll send you a short follow-up message tomorrow, and if you'd like to work on your catalog and CQS score, we can schedule a separate call at a time that suits you — no pressure.

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
